Add Product

Follow the Content & Image Guidelines: use an accurate name and description, list everything included, enter your desired payout in UGX (Lizimas calculates the customer price for you), and at least three clear photos that show the actual item. New listings are reviewed before they go live.

Customer pays: UGX -
You receive: UGX -

Variants (optional — colours/sizes with their own stock counts)

Save your colours and sizes, generate one row per combination, then enter stock for each. Turning on variant stock replaces the single Stock field above for this product.

Orders

Move each item through New → Accepted → Processing → Ready for Handover, then prepare it per the Packaging Guidelines and Fulfilment Guidelines and mark it handed over. Lizimas Store inspects each item before accepting it and taking over delivery.

Loading...

Returns Awaiting Collection

Failed deliveries and customer returns come back here. Collect within 7 days from the original drop-off point, or within 21 days total once moved to the central hub — after that the item may be forfeited.

Loading...

Returns & Refunds

Why an item came back, any evidence photo Lizimas attached, Lizimas' refund decision, and the recorded amount. This is separate from the Returns tab, which is only about physically collecting the item back. Lizimas makes the final call on every refund - you can add your own response below any return.
